items.summary: ovphysx (NVIDIA's USD/Python product in the PhysX repository: 4 .cu files, about 30 CUDA-runtime host files, Warp output arrays, NVIDIA Carbonite/ovstage packman binaries, two NVIDIA-proprietary licence texts) is not ported in this round. Jeff Daily ruled on 2026-11-23 (Question 1 = A) to port the physx/ SDK only and defer ovphysx to a later round once the SDK port is validated; its 70 surface components are scoped_out citing that ruling. A later round needs depends_on warp, a check that the Carbonite/ovstage binaries can be used in a ROCm build, and its C/Python test suites.

HIP runtime defect, ROCm 10.2 CLR on gfx1201: an async device-to-host copy of 16 KiB or less runs as a copy kernel released only at device scope, so a later store to mapped host memory (a kernel, or hipStreamWriteValue32) on the same stream can reach the host before the copied bytes. PhysX's spin-wait read-back read stale results (checked build lost contacts in every run). Workaround committed on the fork: a system-scope fence in bpSignalComplete under __HIP_PLATFORM_AMD__. Issue draft with reproducer in notes for Jeff to file on ROCm/rocm-systems (labels bug, project: clr).
